headline: S&P Lifts Zambia to B- as Debt Restructuring Nears Completion
summary: S&P Global Ratings raised Zambia's sovereign credit rating from CCC+/C to B-/B with a stable outlook, citing economic improvement, debt restructuring progress and fiscal reforms. The upgrade was announced on November 20, 2026.
why: Sovereign credit ratings shape borrowing costs and investor access to international debt markets for governments such as Zambia's. A rating upgrade typically signals reduced default risk.
